task.title: Thanksgiving-week holiday hours rollout
task.objective: Roll out Thanksgiving-week holiday hours (closed Thursday, 6am-10pm Friday, normal hours otherwise) to the eight Pacific stores other than Boise: publish each store's hours, then notify its manager once. Spokane (GEG) also needs an overtime approval for E-4471 first.
task.outcome: Holiday hours are published and each manager is notified once for every store except Boise. The Spokane publish is reconciled with overtime approval AR-30918, which is verified in the store operations system.

success_criteria.description: Holiday hours are published for PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM.
Each of the eight stores' managers is notified once.
Overtime approval AR-30918 for E-4471 at GEG is approved and verified before any Spokane schedule change.

includes: Thanksgiving-week holiday hours for PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM.
Manager notices for those eight stores, one per store.
excludes: Any change to the Spokane schedule before AR-30918 is verified approved.

completed.description: Listed the nine Pacific stores. Holiday hours were 'not published' for all of them.
Requested overtime approval AR-30918 for E-4471 at GEG to cover the extended Friday close. Status was pending at the last successful check.
publish_holiday_hours succeeded for PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM. The GEG publish happened before AR-30918 was approved; see s-obs-geg-before-approval.
notify_manager succeeded for PDX, SEA and TAC.

focus.description: Sending manager notices. The connection to the store operations backend dropped during the GEG notice, and the remaining notices and the approval check were not completed.

next.description: Restore the connection and call get_approval for AR-30918. Record the result before doing anything else.
Ask the user whether the Spokane holiday hours, published before AR-30918 was approved, should be held or reverted until approval.
Check the message log for GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM, then send each missing notice once. Do not resend a notice that was delivered.
Make no further change to the Spokane schedule unless AR-30918 is verified approved. Then reconcile the GEG publish against the approval.
Ask the user to confirm Boise before any change.

statements.text: Roll out Thanksgiving-week holiday hours (closed Thursday, 6am-10pm Friday, normal hours otherwise) to all nine Pacific stores: publish each store's hours, then notify its manager, once each.
Request overtime approval for E-4471 at Spokane (GEG), who is needed to cover the extended Friday close. Do not publish the Spokane schedule until that approval is approved.
Leave Boise (BOI) alone until the user confirms. It is mid-renovation and may be closed all week.
A schedule that puts an employee into overtime may be published only after the store manager approves it (request_overtime_approval, then get_approval).
Before the rollout, list_stores showed holiday hours as 'not published' for all nine stores, including BOI.
publish_holiday_hours returned success for PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM.

The GEG holiday-hours publish succeeded before AR-30918 was approved. This breaks the operator policy and the user's instruction not to publish the Spokane schedule until approval. The agent's earlier report said the Spokane schedule was not published; that was wrong for the holiday hours.

verification.method: review of tool results and approval status

statements.text: AR-30918 was pending at the last successful check. Two get_approval calls after the connection dropped failed, so its current status is unknown.
notify_manager succeeded for PDX, SEA and TAC. Calls for GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM returned an error stating that the session had ended and no action was taken.
No change has been made to Boise (BOI).
A manager notice that failed with 'no action was taken' will not create a duplicate message if it is sent again.
Should the Spokane (GEG) holiday hours, published before AR-30918 was approved, be held or reverted until the approval is verified?

resources.title: Overtime approval AR-30918 (E-4471, GEG)
resources.description: Last read as pending. get_approval failed after the connection dropped.

operations.description: Publish holiday hours for GEG. Done before AR-30918 was approved, contrary to policy and instruction.
Send the holiday-hours notice to the PDX manager.
Send the holiday-hours notice to the SEA manager.
Send the holiday-hours notice to the TAC manager.
Send the GEG manager notice on the holiday hours and on pending AR-30918. Not sent.
Send the holiday-hours notice to the EUG manager. Not sent.
Send the holiday-hours notice to the SLE manager. Not sent.
Send the holiday-hours notice to the BND manager. Not sent.
Send the holiday-hours notice to the OLM manager. Not sent.
Overtime approval AR-30918 for E-4471 at GEG to cover the extended Friday close. Last read as pending; current status unknown.

requirements.name: get_approval
requirements.fallback: None. AR-30918 cannot be verified, so do not act on it and do not publish any Spokane change.

requirements.name: notify_manager
requirements.fallback: None. Report the unsent notices to the user.

requirements.name: publish_holiday_hours
requirements.fallback: Stop. Do not publish holiday hours by any other means.

requirements.name: request_overtime_approval
requirements.fallback: If AR-30918 is no longer pending, ask the user before requesting a new approval.

requirements.name: store operations write access
requirements.description: The destination must already hold permission to publish schedules and send manager notices in store operations.

preconditions.description: The store operations backend is reachable, and a read such as get_approval for AR-30918 succeeds.
The user has said whether the Spokane holiday hours should be held or reverted.

stop_conditions.description: Do not publish or change the Spokane (GEG) schedule until AR-30918 is verified approved in store operations.
Do not change Boise (BOI) until the user confirms.
Do not call publish_holiday_hours for a store whose publish operation is completed.
Do not treat AR-30918 as approved on the strength of this checkpoint. Verify it with get_approval.

recovery.description: Restore the connection to store operations and call get_approval for AR-30918.
Tell the user that the GEG holiday hours were published before AR-30918 was approved, against the policy and their instruction, and ask whether to hold or revert them.
Check the message log for GEG, EUG, SLE, BND and OLM. Send each notice that was not delivered, once. Include the AR-30918 note in the GEG notice only while it is still pending.
Ask the user to confirm Boise before any change.

incompatibilities: The store operations session ended mid-rollout. Approval status and notice delivery must be re-read, not assumed from this checkpoint.
Publish results come from before the session dropped. Store hours may have changed since then.

omissions.description: Timing of individual tool calls and the verbatim error text were summarized.
